scanNote:
GRAMMAR 19-BET. Unit 4 — egalik sifatlari, egalik olmoshlari va egalik kelishigi.

4-mashqda 6 ta kasb surati bor. Skaner bilan tekshirildi, TO'G'RI:
  1 ballerina (kitobda berilgan — sahna libosidagi raqqosa)
  2 firefighters (himoya kiyimidagi IKKI o't o'chiruvchi)
  3 chef (baland oq qalpoqli oshpaz)
  4 vet (mushukni ushlab turgan erkak)
  5 farmer (traktor oldidagi erkak)
  6 music teacher (pianino chalayotgan ayol)

⚠ 2-RASM — YAGONA KO'PLIK: unda IKKI odam bor, shuning uchun javob 'They're FIREFIGHTERS' — artiklsiz va ko'plikda. Qolgan beshtasida bitta odam: 'She's A ballerina', 'He's A chef'. Ro'yxatdagi so'z ham allaqachon ko'plikda berilgan ('firefighters') — bu ip beradi.

5-mashqning 15 ta javobi tekshirildi — to'g'ri (His, our, her, Their, my, his, Its, their, her, your, our, Its, your, My, Their).

7-mashqning 15 ta javobi ham to'g'ri.

⚠ ENG QIYIN JUFTLIK — 'WHO'S' va 'WHOSE':
  WHO'S  = 'who is' qisqartmasi → 'WHO'S he?' = U kim?
  WHOSE  = kimning → 'WHOSE football is this?' = Bu kimning koptogi?
  ⚠ Talaffuzi BIR XIL, ma'nosi butunlay boshqa. 5 va 8-bandda 'Who's', 3 va 7-bandda 'Whose'.

⚠ EGALIK SIFATI va EGALIK OLMOShI:
  my/your/his/her/its/our/their — OT bilan keladi ('my friend')
  mine/yours/his/hers/ours/theirs — OT SIZ turadi ('It's mine')
  ⚠ 1-bandda ikkalasi yonma-yon: 'Is this bicycle YOURS?' (otsiz) — 'Yes, it's MINE.' (otsiz)
  ⚠ 5-bandda esa 'He's MY friend' — ot bor, shuning uchun 'mine' EMAS.

⚠ 2-bandda 'Alex and Rachel's cousin' — ikki ism birga bo'lsa apostrof faqat OXIRGISIGA qo'yiladi (Coursebook 27-betdagi qoida).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and fill in the possessive pronouns/adjectives or the people's names, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va egalik olmoshi/sifati yoki odamlarning ismini qo'ying (18-betdagi 3-mashqning davomi).
exercises.explanationUz:
18-betdagi rasmlar jadvalining davomi:
  Linda  — flowers (gullar)
  John   — umbrella (soyabon)
  Denise — pen (ruchka)

QOLIP o'zgarmaydi:
  Birinchi bo'shliq — OT YO'Q → egalik OLMOSHI (his, hers, theirs, mine, yours)
  Ikkinchi bo'shliq — OT BOR  → egalik SIFATI (his, her, their) yoki ism + 's

lines.hintUz: Linda — ayol. Birinchisi otsiz, ikkinchisi ot bilan
lines.whyUz: Rasmda gullar Lindaniki. Otsiz → hers (olmosh), ot bilan → her (sifat). Bu ikkisi FARQ qiladi.

lines.hintUz: Savolda 'your' — javobda o'zi haqida; rasmda soyabon boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Savolda 'your' → javobda 'mine' (meniki emas). Rasmda soyabon Jonniki → John's.

lines.hintUz: Deniz — ayol. Birinchisi otsiz, ikkinchisi ot bilan
lines.whyUz: Rasmda ruchka Denizniki. Otsiz → hers, ot bilan → her.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the people with their jobs, then ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Odamlarni kasblari bilan belgilang, so'ng namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASBLAR RO'YXATI:
  vet           — veterinar (hayvon shifokori)
  farmer        — dehqon, fermer
  firefighters  — o't o'chiruvchilar (KO'PLIK!)
  music teacher — musiqa o'qituvchisi
  ballerina     — balerina
  chef          — oshpaz (restoranda bosh oshpaz)

RASMLAR:
  1) baletda raqsga tushayotgan ayol → ballerina (namuna)
  2) sariq kiyimdagi ikki kishi      → firefighters
  3) oq qalpoqdagi erkak             → chef
  4) mushuk ushlagan erkak           → vet
  5) traktordagi erkak               → farmer
  6) pianino chalayotgan ayol        → music teacher

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  BIRLIK:  What's his/her job?  — He's/She's a ...
  KO'PLIK: What are their jobs? — They're ...

DIQQAT:
  • birlikda kasb oldida A/AN SHART: She's A ballerina.
  • ko'plikda artikl QO'YILMAYDI: They're firefighters.
  • ko'plikda 'job' ham ko'plikda: their jobS

items.question: What's her job?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Ayol → her / She's. Kasb oldida 'a'.

items.question: What are their jobs?
items.whyUz: IKKI kishi → 'their jobS' (ko'plik) va 'They're'. Ko'plikda artikl YO'Q.

items.question: What's his job?
items.whyUz: Erkak → his / He's. 'chef' o'qilishi 'shef' — fransuz tilidan.

items.question: What's his job?
items.whyUz: Hayvon bilan ishlaydi → vet. To'liq shakli 'veterinary surgeon'.

items.question: What's his job?
items.whyUz: Traktor va ferma → farmer. 'farm' + er.

items.question: What's her job?
items.whyUz: Ayol → her / She's. Qo'shma so'z: music + teacher.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in my, your, his, her, its, our or their.
exercises.instructionUz: my, your, his, her, its, our yoki their — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMASI EGALIK SIFATI — demak har birida keyin OT keladi.

QADAMLAR:
  1) Gapda KIM haqida gapirilyapti? (oldingi gapga qarang)
  2) U erkakmi, ayolmi, narsami, ko'pmi?
  3) Mos egalik sifatini tanlang:
     I → my,  you → your,  he → his,  she → her,
     it → its,  we → our,  they → their

ENG KO'P XATO — 'its' ga apostrof qo'yish:
  ✅ Its name is Rex.   (uning ismi)
  ❌ It's name is Rex.  (bu 'It is name' degani — ma'nosiz)

items.textEn: 1  This is my brother. ____ name is Jonathan.
items.whyUz: 'brother' — erkak → His. Gap boshida katta harf.

items.textEn: 2  We have a computer in ____ classroom.
items.whyUz: 'We' → our.

items.textEn: 3  She lives in New York and ____ pen-friend lives in Paris.
items.whyUz: 'She' → her.

items.textEn: 4  I've got two sisters. ____ names are Julie and Laura.
items.whyUz: 'two sisters' ko'plik → Their. 'names' ham ko'plikda.

items.textEn: 5  I love Oasis. They're ____ favourite group.
items.whyUz: 'I love' → my. Oasis — britaniyalik rok guruh.

items.textEn: 6  Michael's mum is a teacher and ____ father is a pilot.
items.whyUz: Otasi Maykl'niki → his. 'Michael's mum' bilan bir xil egasi.

items.textEn: 7  I've got a car. ____ colour is blue.
items.whyUz: Mashina — narsa → Its. APOSTROF YO'Q!

items.textEn: 8  Ted and Danny live in Canada but ____ parents live in Brazil.
items.whyUz: 'Ted and Danny' ko'plik → their.

items.textEn: 9  She's very kind. Do you know ____ name?
items.whyUz: 'She' → her.
Tanishishda: o'zini aytib, suhbatdoshning ismini so'raydi → your.

items.textEn: 11  There are five of us in ____ family.
items.whyUz: 'us' (biz) → our.

items.textEn: 12  This is Albert's dog. ____ name is Rex.
items.whyUz: It — hayvon, jinsi aytilmagan → Its. Apostrof YO'Q. (Agar jinsi ma'lum bo'lsa 'His' ham bo'lardi.)
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri Chris'ga murojaat → your.

items.textEn: 14  ____ name is Alice and I'm 12 years old.
items.whyUz: 'I'm 12' — o'zi haqida → My. Gap boshida katta harf.

items.textEn: 15  Pam and Janet are very friendly. ____ parents are nice, too.
items.whyUz: 'Pam and Janet' ko'plik → Their.

exercises.instructionEn: Write two sentences using the prompts, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Berilgan so'zlar bilan ikkitadan gap yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  cousin/Wendy → That's my cousin. Her name's Wendy.

QOLIP:
  1-gap: That's my + QARINDOSHLIK.
  2-gap: EGALIK SIFATI + name's + ISM.

EGALIK SIFATINI TANLASH:
  erkak qarindosh (son, brother, husband) → His
  ayol qarindosh (daughter, sister, wife) → Her
  hayvon                                  → Its
  'cousin' — ismga qarab: Wendy ayol → Her

QISQARTMA: name's = name is

example.en: That's my cousin. Her name's Wendy.
example.uz: Bu mening amakivachcham. Uning ismi Vendi.

modelSentences.sentence: That's my son. His name's Tom.
modelSentences.uz: Bu mening o'g'lim. Uning ismi Tom.

modelSentences.sentence: That's my wife. Her name's Carol.
modelSentences.uz: Bu mening xotinim. Uning ismi Kerol.

modelSentences.sentence: That's my brother. His name's Jim.
modelSentences.uz: Bu mening akam. Uning ismi Jim.

modelSentences.sentence: That's my dog. Its name's Spike.
modelSentences.uz: Bu mening itim. Uning ismi Spayk.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word(s) in bold.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ HAMMASINI BIRGA TEKSHIRADI:
  egalik sifati ↔ egalik olmoshi
  Who's ↔ Whose
  ism ↔ ism + 's

UCHTA TEKSHIRUV SAVOLI:

  1) Keyin OT bormi?
     Bor  → egalik SIFATI (my, your, their) yoki ism + 's
     Yo'q → egalik OLMOSHI (mine, yours, theirs)

  2) Savol odam haqidami yoki egalik haqidami?
     Odam  → Who's (= Who is)
     Egalik → Whose

  3) Ikki egasi bo'lsa, 's qayerga?
     FAQAT oxirgi ismga: Alex and Rachel's cousin

items.whyUz: Gap oxirida, ot yo'q → egalik OLMOSHI.
Ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi 'mine'. 'my' dan keyin ot kerak bo'lardi.
Ikki egasi, BITTA amakivachcha → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga.
Keyin 'football' oti keladi va egasi so'ralyapti → Whose.
Ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi 'theirs'.
Egalik ma'nosi kerak → Paul + 's. 'Paul' o'zi shunchaki ism.
Ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi.
Javob 'He's my friend' — odamning kimligi → Who is.
'friend' oti bor → egalik SIFATI 'my'.
Gap oxirida, ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi.
Ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi 'ours'.
Keyin 'guitar' oti keladi → Whose.
Ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi.
Javob 'She's Sally's sister' — odamning kimligi → Who is.
'Sallining singlisi' → Sally + 's. Apostrofsiz 'Sally sister' ma'nosiz.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 19-bet — kasblar va egalik shakllari.

groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida kasb nomlari bir necha xil yasaladi. Ba'zilari boshqa tildan olingan.

groups.ruleUz: Kasb haqida savol — birlik va ko'plik
groups.explanationUz: Ko'plikda uchta narsa birga o'zgaradi: olmosh, fe'l va 'job' so'zi.

items.derived: What's his job? — He's a chef.
What's her job? — She's a ballerina.
What are their jobs? — They're firefighters.

groups.ruleUz: its ↔ it's — eng ko'p chalkashadigan juftlik
groups.explanationUz: Talaffuzi bir xil, ma'nosi butunlay boshqa. Apostrof hal qiluvchi.
Apostrof + s ikki xil bo'lishi mumkin — kontekstdan farqlanadi.

patterns.formula: What's his/her job? — He's/She's a + kasb.
patterns.exampleEn: What's her job? — She's a ballerina.

patterns.formula: What are their jobs? — They're + kasb (ko'plikda).
patterns.exampleEn: What are their jobs? — They're firefighters.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularning kasbi nima? — Ular o't o'chiruvchi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plikda artikl YO'Q va 'jobs' ham ko'plikda.

patterns.formula: That's my + qarindoshlik. + EGALIK SIFATI + name's + ISM.
patterns.exampleEn: That's my cousin. Her name's Wendy.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu mening amakivachcham. Uning ismi Vendi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikkinchi gapda egalik sifati birinchi gapdagi odamga ishora qiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: His name is Jonathan. Their names are Julie and Laura.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning ismi Jonatan. Ularning ismi Juli va Lora.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega bo'lsa, ot ham fe'l ham ko'plikda: nameS ARE.

patterns.formula: Is this + ot + EGALIK OLMOSHI? — Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
patterns.exampleEn: Is this bicycle yours? — Yes, it's mine.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikkala gapda ham ot takrorlanmaydi → egalik olmoshi.

patterns.formula: Whose + ot + is this? — It's + EGALIK OLMOSHI / ISM's.
patterns.exampleEn: Whose guitar is this? — It's theirs.
patterns.explanationUz: 'Whose' dan keyin ot, javobda esa otsiz olmosh.
